info.name: Synaplan Integration
info.summary: AI-powered document summarization, translation, knowledge base, and chat
info.description:
Bring Synaplan's AI capabilities directly into Nextcloud:
- **Summarize** documents with one click - **Translate** files to multiple languages - **Add to Knowledge** — vectorize files into the AI knowledge base - **Research Chat** — AI assistant with knowledge group and model selection, optional personal memories, and live status (model, language, image/video capabilities) - **Configurable answer language** — set a default language and optionally follow each user's Nextcloud interface language
Requires a running Synaplan instance and API key.
info.author: Synaplan
